claim_summaries: A fixed transcript of two noncommuting single-mode fermionic Gaussian hard filters is not equivalent, as a map up to scale, to one orthogonal hard projection after a Gaussian unitary: K* K has exact nonzero eigenvalues 1 and 9/25.

An outcome-dependent sequential occupation-filtering protocol on a four-mode Gaussian pair state yields a non-Gaussian coarse-grained data mixture with number probabilities 1/3 in each of N=0,1,2 and both parities present.
A single terminal global N=2 projection of a four-mode BCS Gaussian state can yield the non-Slater pure state (|12>+|34>)/sqrt(2), outside the Gaussian branch class.
